move.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. You did your homework with those material and energy numbers, I have to admit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Faster payment at 14 days is good for my shop, so I am dropping the price to €31.50. 

So our offer is a price of €31.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Let me know if we have a deal so we can start making chips.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that index change data into account, and we checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Hi, thanks for the email. The other offer you mentioned is basically the same as our starting price anyway! 

I looked at your packages, but 35 days lead time is too tight for us and would cost more, so I changed it back to 52 days. If we do 52 days lead time and your 14 days payment, I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR per piece. Let's get this going!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
